profiles.short_purpose: Highlights terms that became unusually distinctive in one year versus the adjacent year.
profiles.canonical_usage: Weighted log-odds with informative priors is used to compare token distinctiveness across corpora with uneven counts.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab applies the method to adjacent Item 1A sections only, after lens-specific cleaning and stop controls, then surfaces top evidence snippets instead of full corpus diagnostics.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when both years have comparable section length and the dominant risk themes are expressed with specific, repeated terminology.
failure_modes: Can overreact to one-off proper nouns, legal entities, or formatting tokens when cleaning is weak.
Can understate gradual semantic drift when wording changes but core terms stay stable.
Can look noisy when section length changes sharply between years.
profiles.why_included_here: It gives fast lexical drift intuition and a transparent ranked list that non-technical audiences can inspect immediately.
alternatives_not_chosen: TF-IDF cosine-only scoring was not primary because it hides term-level directionality.
Embedding-only similarity was not primary because evidence traceability is weaker for quick audits.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Still common in computational social science, policy-text comparison, and interpretable NLP diagnostics.

origin_claims.title: Fightin' Words: Lexical Feature Selection and Evaluation for Identifying the Content of Political Conflict

profiles.short_purpose: Measures distributional drift in n-gram usage across adjacent years.
profiles.canonical_usage: Jensen-Shannon divergence is used as a symmetric, bounded divergence measure between probability distributions.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab applies JSD to filing-section n-gram distributions rather than broad document collections, then pairs scores with curated evidence snippets for interpretation.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when tokenization is stable and the pair has enough text volume for reliable n-gram distributions.
failure_modes: High score can reflect style or formatting churn, not business-risk substance.
Low score can hide important but localized narrative changes.
Sensitive to tokenization and cleaning decisions.
profiles.why_included_here: It provides a stable distribution-level signal that complements term-level rankings and helps detect broad wording shifts.
alternatives_not_chosen: KL divergence was avoided as the primary drift score because asymmetry complicates stakeholder interpretation.
Wasserstein distance was not selected as baseline due additional modeling complexity for this scope.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Widely used in NLP drift checks, topic distribution monitoring, and model/data shift diagnostics.

origin_claims.title: Divergence Measures Based on the Shannon Entropy

profiles.short_purpose: Estimates how much language is near-duplicate across adjacent years.
profiles.canonical_usage: MinHash approximates Jaccard similarity for large set comparisons at lower compute and memory cost.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab uses paragraph-level shingles from Item 1A sections and reports reuse-oriented evidence instead of only a global similarity estimate.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when repeated legal language is substantial and the goal is separating boilerplate continuity from novel risk edits.
failure_modes: Misses semantically similar paraphrases when exact shingle overlap is low.
Can overstate stability when legal boilerplate dominates section volume.
Threshold choices can change reuse counts materially.
profiles.why_included_here: It separates true narrative change from repetitive filing boilerplate and improves confidence calibration for other drift detectors.
alternatives_not_chosen: Exact full-text diff as primary reuse detector was avoided for fragility to minor edits.
Embedding-nearest-neighbor reuse detection was deferred due lower determinism.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Still standard in near-duplicate detection, web/document deduplication, and scalable record-linkage pipelines.

origin_claims.title: On the Resemblance and Containment of Documents

profiles.short_purpose: Finds shared exact fingerprint spans that persist between years.
profiles.canonical_usage: Winnowing selects representative fingerprints from k-grams to detect shared passages robustly with bounded guarantees.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab applies winnowing to filing paragraphs for traceable overlap evidence and combines it with drift/structure cards rather than standalone plagiarism detection.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when overlap spans are exact or near-exact and reviewers need concrete retained-phrase anchors.
failure_modes: Insensitive to semantic changes that keep only partial wording overlap.
Fingerprint density depends on k-gram/window settings.
Can surface low-value matches when repetitive disclosure templates dominate.
profiles.why_included_here: It gives an interpretable exact-overlap lens that complements MinHash approximations and grounds structure-level continuity claims.
alternatives_not_chosen: Suffix-array matching was not selected for baseline due implementation complexity for this product phase.
Pure edit-distance approaches were deprioritized for scale and readability tradeoffs.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Used in document overlap checks, plagiarism systems, and code/text provenance tooling.

origin_claims.title: Winnowing: Local Algorithms for Document Fingerprinting

profiles.short_purpose: Flags heading, section-shape, and structural artifact changes between years.
profiles.canonical_usage: Document structure analysis is commonly used to detect template changes, section drift, and formatting artifacts that can confound lexical metrics.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab focuses on Item 1A heading/segment artifacts and links findings directly to evidence cards and deterministic agreement context.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when filings undergo template or heading reorganization that could otherwise distort lexical drift interpretation.
failure_modes: Can report strong change when content is stable but formatting schema changed.
Can miss subtle semantic shifts when structure is unchanged.
Heading extraction heuristics can be brittle on irregular filings.
profiles.why_included_here: It prevents false confidence from lexical-only signals by exposing structural churn explicitly.
alternatives_not_chosen: Full document layout parsing with external OCR/layout engines was out of scope for deterministic static runtime.
Heavy template-classification models were excluded to keep runtime deterministic and transparent.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Common in compliance document QA, contract analytics, and reporting template governance.

profiles.short_purpose: Quantifies rank-list agreement across deterministic detectors.
profiles.canonical_usage: Rank-Biased Overlap compares top-weighted ranked lists with configurable depth sensitivity.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab applies RBO as an agreement summary across detector outputs for the same case instead of IR-system benchmark ranking evaluation.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when multiple ranked detectors are available and stakeholders need a compact concordance view before deeper analysis.
failure_modes: Can mask disagreements that occur below the top-weighted depth.
Agreement score can be high even when detector rationales differ.
Interpretation depends on ranked list quality from upstream detectors.
profiles.why_included_here: It provides a compact consistency signal before users dive into method-specific evidence.
alternatives_not_chosen: Kendall tau and Spearman were not primary because unequal list lengths and top-weighting are central here.
Pairwise overlap counts alone were too shallow for confidence framing.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Used in IR evaluation and rank aggregation diagnostics where top-weighted overlap matters.

origin_claims.title: A Similarity Measure for Indefinite Rankings

profiles.short_purpose: Produces an evidence-cited narrative summary of directional risk changes.
profiles.canonical_usage: LLM summarization is often used to condense long text into analyst-readable deltas with citation markers.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab never calls models at runtime; summaries are precomputed offline under strict JSON and citation-to-evidence validation rules.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when evidence blocks are balanced across years and prompts enforce mechanism-level narrative structure.
failure_modes: Can become templated or generic if prompt controls are weak.
Narrative may over-compress nuance if citations are sparse.
Quality can drift across model versions despite similar labels.
profiles.why_included_here: It gives a fast narrative layer for comparison while keeping deterministic evidence and provenance constraints explicit.
alternatives_not_chosen: Runtime model calls were rejected for security, determinism, and deploy-cost reasons.
Free-form prose without citation linkage was rejected due traceability risk.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Used in analyst copilots and document-review workflows, usually with retrieval and grounding controls.

origin_claims.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

profiles.short_purpose: Selects representative excerpt pairs with explicit rationale and highlights.
profiles.canonical_usage: Extractive LLM workflows prioritize span selection tied to source passages for traceable review.
profiles.this_app_deviation: The lab constrains outputs to strict excerpt-set equality, verbatim snippet checks, and bounded snippet length for reproducibility.
profiles.when_it_works_well: Works best when representative paragraphs can be captured with concise verbatim spans and explicit why-rationale.
failure_modes: Can favor obvious excerpts and miss subtle but material lines.
Selection quality degrades when evidence constraints are violated.
Model output style may vary unless campaign contract is tightly locked.
profiles.why_included_here: It exposes concrete before-vs-after passages for side-by-side model and detector comparison.
alternatives_not_chosen: Abstractive-only summaries were not accepted because exact source traceability is weaker.
Embedding-based excerpt retrieval was deferred to preserve strict deterministic auditability.
profiles.current_industry_usage: Increasingly used in compliance and legal review copilots where grounded extraction is required.
